arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import pandas as pd
xl = pd.ExcelFile('budget.xlsx')
print('Sheets:', xl.sheet_names)
for s in xl.sheet_names:
    df = pd.read_excel(xl, sheet_name=s, header=None)
    print(f'--- Sheet: {s} ({df.shape[0]} rows x {df.shape[1]} cols) ---')
    print(df.to_string())
"

python3 -c "
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_excel('budget.xlsx', sheet_name='Budget', header=None)

# Expenses are in column C (index 2), rows 11-22 (Excel) => pandas rows 10-21
expenses = df.iloc[10:22, 2]
print('Expense items and amounts:')
for _, row in df.iloc[10:22].iterrows():
    print(f'  {row[0]:<15} {row[1]:<15} {row[2]:>8.2f}')
total = expenses.sum()
print(f'\nTotal Expenses: {total:.2f}')

# Verification: sum by category
by_cat = df.iloc[10:22].groupby(0)[2].sum()
print('\nBy category:')
print(by_cat.to_string())
print(f'\nGrand total by category: {by_cat.sum():.2f}')
"
